desc: Read the input values $N$ and the sequence $P$.
Implement a Fenwick Tree class supporting `update(index, delta)` and `query(index)`.
Implement a helper function `find_kth(k)` using binary lifting on the Fenwick Tree to find the index where the cumulative sum equals `k`.
Initialize an array `result` of size $N$ (or $N+1$ for 1-based indexing convenience) and a Fenwick tree of size $N$ initialized with 1s.
Iterate backwards from $i = N$ down to $1$:
Get the target rank $P_i$ (adjusting for 0-based indexing if necessary).
Use `find_kth` to determine the actual index in the `result` array corresponding to the $P_i$-th available position.
Place the number $i$ at that index in the `result` array.
Update the Fenwick tree to mark this position as occupied (decrement the count at that index).
Print the elements of the `result` array separated by spaces.
Run the code against Sample 1 and Sample 2 to verify correctness.
